title: energy-for-kokkos: per-region energy attribution for Kokkos applications
description: Attributes measured GPU energy to the regions and kernels of a Kokkos application. A KokkosP connector records an NVML power trace and the region timestamps; a single Rust binary integrates the trace per region and kernel and reports it as a console table, a Perfetto trace and a standalone HTML report. Independent tool, not an official Kokkos project.
